mctgauth.settings.title: MCTGAuth Settings
mctgauth.settings.storage_warning: The MCTGAuth password is stored locally on this computer. Do not share your Minecraft configuration folder.
mctgauth.auth.password_required: This server requires MCTGAuth authentication. Enter the password issued by the Telegram bot.
mctgauth.auth.stored_rejected: Stored MCTGAuth password was rejected. Check the password issued by the Telegram bot.
mctgauth.error.invalid_credentials:
Authentication failed.

Check your MCTGAuth password in the client settings.
mctgauth.error.timeout:
Authentication timed out.

Reconnect to the server and try again.
mctgauth.error.protocol_mismatch:
Your MCTGAuth version is incompatible with the server.

Update the modpack or MCTGAuth and try again.
mctgauth.error.mod_required: This server requires MCTGAuth Client. Install the required mod and reconnect.
mctgauth.error.account_disabled:
This Minecraft profile is blocked.

Contact the server administration for more information.
mctgauth.error.full_reset:
Server authentication data has been reset.
You must register again before joining the server.
mctgauth.error.account_not_found:
No registration data was found for this Minecraft profile.

Make sure this nickname is registered through the Telegram bot and matches your current Minecraft name.
mctgauth.error.account_not_synchronized:
Your profile data has not yet synchronized with the game server.

Try again later. If the problem persists, contact an administrator.
mctgauth.error.credential_outdated:
Your MCTGAuth password has changed.

Update the saved password in the client settings and reconnect.
mctgauth.error.verification_failed:
Authentication could not be verified.

Reconnect to the server. If the error persists, contact an administrator.
mctgauth.error.internal:
An internal authentication error occurred.

Try again later. If the problem persists, contact an administrator.
